name: assisted lying calves stretch
description: A partner-assisted stretch lying on your back for the calves. It lengthens the lower leg.
instructions: Lie on your back and let your partner lift one leg while the other rests on the floor.
Your partner supports the heel and gently draws the toes toward you until you feel a comfortable calf stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without forcing the knee or ankle, then lower the leg and switch sides.
